corrections.why: The register gives no current condition and records no site visit for this tower, so 'standing' is not supported by the sources read.

notes_for_editor: One usable source only. The register gives the location, elevation (512 ft / 156 m), a 100 ft Aermotor description, build date unknown, registration details and the agency, and nothing else. height_m 30.5 is the register's 100 ft converted. Two WebSearch queries and a few page reads found nothing more: the anyplaceamerica, mapcarta and topozone directory pages are map listings; the Wikipedia article on Reid was cached only as wikitext with no history; the Forest Lookouts Mississippi list does not include Reid; the msgw.org Calhoun City history fails on an expired certificate, and it describes two CCC-built lookouts (near Wardwell and on Gauley Mountain) that are not this tower, so it was not used. Register photos carry 2022-02-05 upload stamps; these are not treated as a site visit. The status correction is proposed because 'standing' in the record has no source. No access key set. Staffing, notable fires, fate and current condition are unknown. Story and facts should be revisited if an MFC or local source turns up.
